name: Whalesync
title: whalesync.com
shortDescription: Whalesync allows users to update their website, CRM, or app content directly from a spreadsheet like Airtable, Notion, or Google Sheets. It's designed for businesses of all sizes, from startups to enterprises, enabling them to manage data through two-way synchronization without needing technical skills. Example use case: A marketing team updates promotional content on their website by simply editing a linked spreadsheet.
pros: No technical skills required for setup
Supports popular platforms like Airtable and Notion
